title: Google admits AI search makes less money, but it's fixing that with more ads
hook_text: Google AI search makes less money
script:
Google admits its new AI search makes less money than traditional web pages.
Negative cash flow ballooned to nine billion sixty million dollars in the third quarter.
Google stock prices tumbled following the earnings report release.
AI queries require heavy compute power while showing fewer ad placements.
Google is fixing the revenue gap by packing more advertisements into AI search results.
Will you keep using AI search if it gets filled with ads?
